content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a personal task list","i_want":"to edit the title, description, priority and due date of an existing task","so_that":"my task details stay accurate and up to date","business_description":"Users change task details after they are created. The edit form reuses the create/edit form, and the backend validates each change and records when the task was last updated.","business_value":"Keeps task information accurate without deleting and recreating tasks, and the Last Updated Date shows when a task was last changed.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a title, description, priority and due date","when":"the user opens the task in edit mode, changes the title and saves","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title when reloaded"},{"given":"an existing task being edited","when":"the user submits an empty title","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-03-10","when":"the user saves a Due Date of 2024-03-09","then":"the backend rejects the update, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"an existing task being edited","when":"the user sets Priority to a value other than Low, Medium or High","then":"the backend rejects the update and the stored Priority is unchanged"},{"given":"an update request for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend receives the update","then":"the backend returns a task-not-found error and no task is created or changed"},{"given":"a task update that the backend rejects or fails to save","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend shows the error message and still shows the previous task values, not a success state"},{"given":"a task update that the backend saves successfully","when":"the save completes","then":"the frontend shows a success message and the Last Updated Date of the task is set to the time of the save"}],"edge_cases":["Editing a task does not change its Status or Creation Date (the PRD does not say the Creation Date is editable; treat it as read-only until clarified).","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is allowed; only a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date is rejected.","Whitespace-only titles: the PRD says the title cannot be empty but does not say whether whitespace counts as empty (open question).","Last Updated Date is not listed in US-create-task, which creates the table; this story adds the column and records the change time on update. Confirm whether the field must also exist for newly created tasks.","Submitting an edit with no changed values: the PRD does not say whether this updates Last Updated Date (open question)."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["The update endpoint rejects empty titles, Due Dates earlier than the Creation Date, and Priority values outside Low, Medium and High, each with a specific error response.","The update endpoint returns a not-found error for a task ID that does not exist.","Last Updated Date is stored in the tasks table and is set on every successful update.","The edit form is pre-filled with the current task values and reuses the create/edit form component.","The frontend shows a success or error message after every update and does not show success before the backend confirms it.","Automated tests cover each validation rule, the not-found case, and the success and failure message paths.","Open questions on whitespace-only titles and no-change saves are recorded in the story notes for product confirmation."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"tasks-last-updated-date-column","title":"[BE] Add Last Updated Date column to the tasks table","track":"backend","area":"db","description":"Add a last_updated_date column to the tasks table through a migration. Existing rows get a value based on their creation date or are set to null, as the team decides. Create-task does not list this field, so this task adds it.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-31569dba"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Migration adds the last_updated_date column and runs on a clean and an existing database.","Migration can be rolled back without data loss to other columns.","Existing rows have a documented value for last_updated_date."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-validation","title":"[BE] Validate and save task updates in the update endpoint","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Extend the shared update endpoint so it validates title, description, priority and due date on update, compares Due Date with the stored Creation Date, returns a not-found error for unknown IDs, and sets Last Updated Date on each successful save.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-9fb58566","R-31569dba","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Empty titles, invalid priorities and Due Dates earlier than Creation Date are rejected with distinct error codes.","Updating a non-existent task returns a not-found error and writes nothing.","Successful updates set last_updated_date to the save time.","Error responses follow the simple error format defined for the shared endpoints.","Unit tests cover each rule and the not-found path."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Pre-fill the task form in edit mode and submit updates","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add edit mode to the shared create/edit form: load the current task values, allow changes to title, description, priority and due date, and send the update to the backend. Do not show success until the backend confirms the save.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-aaf23206","R-c9046f7a","R-9fb58566","R-71bdd372"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Opening a task shows its current title, description, priority and due date in the form.","Priority is a choice of Low, Medium and High.","The form does not show success while the update request is pending or after it fails.","The form reuses the create/edit component from US-create-task."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-feedback","title":"[FE] Show success and error messages after a task update","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Display a success message after a saved update and an error message after a rejected or failed update, showing the backend error text where it is available.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["A success message appears only after the backend confirms the update.","An error message appears for validation errors, not-found errors and server errors.","Previous task values remain visible after a failed update."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for task editing and update validation","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Write end-to-end and API tests for the edit flow: successful updates, each validation rule, the not-found case, the message display, and the rule that no success state appears before the backend confirms.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover each acceptance criterion of this story.","Tests run in the CI pipeline and pass.","A failing backend response is tested to confirm the UI shows no success state."]}]}
